content:
Ana: Quick ping — PR #17455 is failing CI on integration-shard6 (macOS) with a snapshot mismatch in TestKVLeaseExpiry. Need a quick triage: flake or snapshot update? @Mike @Sophie
Mike: Can you paste the failing diff or logs?
Ana: Sure — here's the failing assertion snippet from the CI log:
```
AssertionError: Expected lease TTL 30s but got 29s- snapshot mismatch: expected 'lease_expires_in: 30s' got 'lease_expires_in: 29s'
Stack: tests/integration/test_kv.py::TestKVLeaseExpiry
```
Sophie: Hmm that looks like a 1s timing drift. Was the test changed recently or any scheduling tweaks in the runtime?
Ana: No changes to that test in this PR, only an unrelated config tweak to batching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/17455
CI Bot: buildkite: Build #45678 failed on integration-shard6 — tests/integration/test_kv.py::TestKVLeaseExpiry — full logs: <https://ci.example.com/builds/45678|link>
Mike: If it's likely timing, try a targeted rerun of shard6 first. @CI Bot can you rerun just that shard?
Sophie: +1 to rerun. If it flakes again twice we should consider updating the snapshot with a note or adding a small tolerance.
Ana: Kicking off rerun now — running `ci-run --pr 17455 --shard 6`
CI Bot: buildkite: Rerun Build #45679 started (targeted: integration-shard6)
CI Bot: buildkite: Build #45679 (rerun) passed — all tests in integration-shard6 green.
Mike: Nice, looks like a transient. I'll add a short comment on the PR documenting the flaky snapshot and that we reran.
Sophie: Also file a follow-up to investigate macOS timing variance on lease expiry tests — might be noisy on slower mac runners.
Ana: Will do. Plan: merge once we have 2 approvals and green. @Jae can you take a quick look?
Jae: Scanned changes, nothing risky. LGTM — approving now.
Ana: Approved + green, merging now. Thanks everyone :tada:
Mike: Thanks! If it reappears after merge tag me and we'll revisit adding tolerance or a skip on mac until root cause found.
Sophie: Agreed — tracking issue created: ENG-4021
Ana: Noted. Closing the loop here.
